description:
Eba Yuzuki, a girl from Tokyo moves to a countryside to attend high school. She lives together with a guy named Kirishima Haruto whose father is an apprentice of Eba's father. Haruto never agrees to let Yuzuki stay at his house and always rejects her. Another girl, Kanzaki Nanami, comes whom Haruto might be in love with. So... what will happen in this story?

(Source: MangaHelpers)

node.description:
__Height:__ 175 cm

The male protagonist of the series. He has a reserved personality, which causes him to become perturbed by Yuzuki and his sister's actions. He has a very strong sense of responsibility and consideration for others. He became a member of the school cooking club because he thought that Nanami would also join.  Before the series, he always lived in his hometown. He met a lost Yuzuki during the festival while they were children; he took care of her and told her that if she ever had problems she could come see him again. Entering in middle school he secretly had a crush on Nanami.  At the beginning of the series when Yuzuki had come to his house, he was irritated with her and did not remember meeting her before. But he becomes protective of her and they become good friends. Thanks to Yuzuki he gets closer to Nanami and finally confesses his love to her, but Nanami replies that she wants them to stay friends and tells him that she wants more time to think. Yuzuki also confesses her love to him, saying that he'll fall for her eventually, but she believes that first he'll end up with Nanami.

__Height:__ 155 cm

Yuzuki moved from Tokyo to her father's hometown. She is staying with the Kirishimas, who are her father's acquaintances. She has a sociable personality and gets along with others easily. She confesses that she likes Haruto, but it does not prevent her from helping [Haruto](https://anilist.co/character/17402/Kirishima-Haruto) get closer to [Nanami](https://anilist.co/character/17403/Kanzaki-Nanami).

__Height:__ 163 cm 

She is Haruto's elder sister. She came back home from college in Tokyo to student teach in order to get her teaching license. Out of the two siblings she acts the least mature. In Tokyo, she lives in Ayano Fujikawa's dormitory and is next door to Yamato Akitsuki. She is the one who shows Haruto a picture of when he first met Eba when they were children. She thinks that Haruto and Yuzuki make a better couple than with him and Nanami. She is a heavy smoker, extremely lazy, and leaves her room trashed, which usually results in Haruto doing most of her chores. Haruto lived in the dormitory with Aoi, until he got his own apartment.

__Birthplace:__ Fukushima 
__Height:__ 157 cm 

Asuka Mishima is Haruto's classmate. She is also a friend and neighbor of Haruto's older sister, Aoi. She enters Haruto's life after mistaking him for a burglar and subduing him with a baseball bat.

__Birthplace:__ Hiroshima 
__Height:__ 161 cm 

She is Haruto's classmate and love interest since middle school. She has a modest personality and is somewhat insecure as she once stated that she felt like an outsider with Haruto, Yuzuki, Takashi, and Akari.

__Height:__ 148 cm 

Itsuki's younger sister and Yuzuki's step-sister, who is a year older than her. She is quite fond of her older brother, and is irritated by Yuzuki, saying that she acts nice just for attention. She has also been known to tell lies in order to make Yuzuki upset. She seems to mischievous and loves to cause trouble. She shows a slight interest in Haruto.

__Birthplace:__ Hiroshima 
__Height:__ 174 cm 

He is Haruto's childhood friend. He has a crush on Yuzuki which makes him jealous of Haruto because he lives with her. His first love was Aoi even though she did not take him seriously. After finding about Yuzuki's sister Rin, he decided to give up on Yuzuki, but instead pursued her sister. Later, near the end of the summer, it was revealed that he confessed to and was rejected by Rin.

__Birthplace:__ Hiroshima 
__Height:__ 167 cm 

She is Haruto's friend since childhood. She has a cheerful personality, but according to Haruto, she often hides her feelings from others. As a child she was a tomboy, often getting into fights because her father was Russian and she inherited his blue eyes and light hair. Haruto and Takashi take her side in childhood and the three become inseparable friends. She is part of the tennis club along with Yuzuki.

__Birthplace:__ Tokyo
__Height:__ 174 cm 

He is Haruto's classmate and friend who cherishes the exhilaration brought by riding his motorcycle. He afflicted by an unspecified illness which prevents him from fulfilling his future aspiration to race professionally.

Haruto's high school classmate in Tokyo. When Haruto asks her out to a festival visit at Yuzuki's school, she interprets it as a date and starts criticizing him, but later begins to feel sympathetic and mistakenly believes Haruto likes her, leading to confusion. She later gives up, and tells Haruto she is dating someone from another class, although she occasionally reappears from a distance, and misinterprets more of Haruto's actions. At college, she meets Haruto as a member of their Outdoor Circle, whose leader thinks she's a bit strange. Haruto updates her on his current life and tries to tell her about Yuzuki, but, due to a bad choice of words, along with Mina's misunderstanding and Haruto never mentioning Yuzuki by name, Mina believes Haruto wants to date her, and was displeased when Haruto never called her.
